note: Append-only queue of open research questions, one entry per platform and question. Rows are never deleted or edited once written: closure is a status change on the row (status: open -> closed with an outcome note), and the row itself stays with its trail. Append-only so nothing asked and nothing answered can disappear. Appenders: the owner/research directly, the writer (gaps surfaced while using tools/brief.py), and QC (tools/qc-to-queue.py translates a qc-notes.json into rows; no QC logic lives in the tool - QC is an LLM step). Every row records who asked and why; 'evidence_that_would_resolve' states what would close it. Seeds below are carried-over open items from the 2026-10-27 run's own record; they are questions, not evidence.

row_format.question: the open question, verbatim
row_format.why: why it is open / what triggered it
row_format.evidence_that_would_resolve: what evidence would close it (first-party preferred)
row_format.status: open until closed; closed rows keep their outcome
